canonical_title: Scientists call for international AI containment and incident registry body
aliases: Geoffrey Hinton Yoshua Bengio air-gapping letter
treatment: Covered in 2026-10-13 Night; repeat only on concrete post-publication hard delta.
known_facts: Reuters 2026-10-13 10:02 UTC reports hundreds of researchers from more than 30 countries signed a new open letter calling for high-assurance containment and independent oversight.
Proposal includes initially air-gapping cyber-capable frontier models and creating an international body to register and ultimately publish major incidents.
This is a proposal, not an enacted regulator or mandatory rule.
reinclude_only_if: An international body is formally constituted or receives government mandate.
Signatories publish operational standards, incident taxonomy, or concrete adopted containment rules.
notes: Signature count differs across reports; use hundreds rather than fixed number until primary letter confirmed.
